en.title: Clearer multilingual handovers: five fictional workplace examples
en.body: Businesses working across languages can use clear handovers, clarification and written guidance. Read five illustrative training scenarios from other service sectors—not a vehicle transaction, automotive client case study or promise of results.

ru.title: Понятная передача информации на разных языках: пять вымышленных рабочих ситуаций
